notes: THE APP NO LONGER WAITS FOR YOU TO PRESS RESCAN. The monitor list was a saved cache whose only writer was that button, so every launch ran on whatever a human last asked for. Proved on this machine: the cache claimed one monitor, a live…
Rescan stays, as a manual refresh rather than the only source of truth.
The editor is told when the displays change, so its list stops being out of date while you are looking at it. A monitor that has gone away also clears any selection pointing at it.

Unplug a monitor and the panel comes back to the corner you put it in, not the middle of the screen. Where you place it now records WHICH edges it was against, so that intent can be honoured on a different display. A panel you had floating…
A panel placed before this update does not have to be moved once to gain that: its alignment is worked out from where it is currently sitting.
